PLAN "12-Week Cycle-Synced Strength Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "build total-body strength while syncing training to menstrual cycle"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Flow Day 1 Recovery Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          cat_cow 3x8..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Flow Day 2 Gentle Core and Upper":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x10..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 3x10..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          internal_rotation 3x10..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x15..30 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Flow Day 3 Mobility and Stretch":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          child_pose 3x60 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          pigeon_pose 3x45 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          spinal_twist 3x45 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 3x45 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 3x45 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength Intro":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Sunday training 55m "Upper Body Strength Intro":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Strength + Accessories":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Strength + Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x4 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Whole Body Moderate":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Strength Peak (Follicular)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Strength Peak":

          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Whole Body Moderate-Heavy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Pre-Flow Mobility + Light Circuit":

      DAY Friday training 45m "Pre-Flow Easy Cardio + Stretch":
